# Not Salmon

> A curated collection of self-help wisdom and life philosophy resources focused on meaningful living and personal transformation.

Not Salmon aggregates insights from leading self-help authors and life philosophers, with a particular focus on Karen Salmansohn's work and related personal development literature. The site emphasizes practical guidance for living purposefully and authentically.

## Key Topics

- Karen Salmansohn
- self-help
- meaningful living
- personal development
- life philosophy
- mortality awareness
- authentic living
- Your To Die For Life
- transformational books
- life wisdom

## Featured Books

- [Your To-Die-For Life - Karen Salmansohn](https://www.notsalmon.com/books/your-to-die-for-life): Karen Salmansohn's self-help book on meaningful living and personal development
